tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Renal function markers show mildly decreased creatinine, likely reflecting low muscle mass in this elderly patient rather than true renal dysfunction. Chloride is slightly elevated and total CO₂ is mildly decreased, suggesting a possible mild non-anion gap metabolic acidosis. Other parameters are within normal limits. Correlate with clinical context and consider further evaluation if symptoms or additional abnormalities are present.
